current_direction.density: Spacious; use deliberate blank space. Avoid an over-packed first viewport.
current_direction.rectangles: Fewer rectangular boxes. Cards are acceptable where useful, but not as the dominant language everywhere.
current_direction.banners: Use image-led banners. The business explicitly said the supplied pictures are for banners.
current_direction.hierarchy: Strong, obvious H1/H2/H3 visual hierarchy. Important category labels must not look like small eyebrows.
current_direction.separators: Avoid obvious horizontal/vertical separator lines between major sections when whitespace can create structure.
current_direction.numbering: Do not show decorative sequence numbers such as 01/02/03/04.
current_direction.chinese_characters: Replace decorative Chinese characters with French on the public site.
current_direction.navigation: Accueil / Services / Solutions / Contact aligned on the right close to 'Parler de votre projet'.
current_direction.home_hero: Use 'Ensemble, on avance.' as the hero focus. Do not show the large Avenzo Studio title or the France-China map in the hero.
current_direction.expertise_section: '4 expertises' must be a large, bold focal heading.
current_direction.services: Keep the liked two-column service structure; service family name is the primary heading and the explanatory phrase is secondary. Keep detailed capability presentation on the right without lines.
current_direction.solutions: Solution category names are primary headings; remove redundant brown labels, section numbers and separator lines.
current_direction.contact: Keep the overall form structure; rebalance the left information area and remove its separator line.
current_direction.footer: Footer should reflect the website structure and support SEO/internal navigation.

interaction.required: Simple click-through interaction: clicking an expertise/service takes the visitor directly to the corresponding detailed section.
interaction.historical_wording: la version simple tu clique il reviens sur la section correspondantes
interaction.avoid: Interaction for its own sake, autoplay theme labs, or development controls in production.
